title: PxCorpus: A Spoken Drug Prescription Dataset in French
why_promising: Primary French speech collected experimentally from 55 participants; 4+ hours; 1,981 synchronized PxSLU recording rows documented; transcripts are human-verified/manually transcribed and semantic annotations are manual; public WAV archive plus paths, participant metadata, transcripts, intent/entity labels, dialogue events and manual dialogue quality labels.
open_question: Current public documentation establishes human transcript/semantic verification but not phonetic segment boundaries, acoustic landmarks, or manual acoustic measurements. Keep out of core until archive inspection shows qualifying phonetic-production annotations/measurements beyond orthographic/semantic annotation.
annotation_status: human-verified transcription + manual semantic/dialogue labels; phonetic qualification unresolved
